sentences.en: There was a pervasive nasty undertone in their writings.
sentences.zh: 他们的作品中弥漫着一股恶劣的基调。

sentences.en: Cares and worries were pervasive in her mind.
sentences.zh: 忧虑和烦恼充斥着她的脑海。

sentences.en: That kind of thinking is pervasive.

senses.zh: 无处不在的;遍布的;充斥各处的 -

mnemonic: 词根记忆：per（贯穿）+vas（走）+ive（…的） →全部走遍→无处不在的
